name: Defending Yourself
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of personal defense and justice, as seen in Exodus where restitution is required for theft and lethal force against a thief breaking in is permitted. The Psalms affirm that God is our refuge and strength, empowering believers to face conflict with courage and skill. Yet Proverbs warns against the shame of a righteous person succumbing to the wicked, highlighting the importance of standing firm. Jesus references the principle of 'an eye for an eye,' underscoring the biblical foundation for measured justice and the right to defend oneself.
